question: Should OpenClaw publish a public OpenAPI/Swagger contract for Gateway programmatic access, and if so should it be a static release artifact, an authenticated runtime endpoint, or a documented TypeBox/JSON Schema generation path?
rationale: The choice defines a supported external Gateway API surface, including auth, endpoint visibility, schema versioning, and upgrade compatibility, so automation should not choose the contract shape without maintainer intent.

options.title: Design Public Schema Contract First
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers decide schema format, exposure path, versioning model, and security boundary before implementation.

options.title: Narrow To Static Artifact
options.body: Publish a release-attached or committed schema artifact for client generation without adding a runtime endpoint yet.

options.title: Defer To Existing Protocol Docs
options.body: Close later only if maintainers decide the TypeBox/JSON Schema pipeline and Gateway protocol docs are the intended client-generation surface.

recommendation.title: Design Public Schema Contract First
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers decide schema format, exposure path, versioning model, and security boundary before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the closest prior OpenAPI/schema implementation history, while steipete should remain a likely reviewer for the Gateway protocol boundary.
